suite.name: 零售分析题集
suite.description: 配 tests/fixtures/acceptance/retail_trends.py 的虚构零售库（数据源名 retail_trends）：上周销售额下降主要来自华东、退款率的结构变化（辛普森）、订单数的常规波动、取消单激增、线上销售额持续上升、线上销售额的变化来自订单数、小样本门店的退款率、本周和上周不可比。期望的来源、判定都由平台的分析方法在期望 SQL 的结果上算，不靠人填。用于分析能力的回归和真实模型验收；店名、金额都是虚构的

cases.question: 上周销售额为什么下降？

gold.sql: SELECT s.region AS 地区, date(o.order_date, 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS 周, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS 销售额 FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date BETWEEN date('{{ schedule.last_week_start }}', '-7 days') AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}' GROUP BY 地区, 周 ORDER BY 地区, 周

expectations.label: 上周销售额的下降主要来自哪个地区

gold.sql: SELECT channel AS 渠道, date(order_date, 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS 周, SUM(status = 'refunded') AS 退款单数, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND order_date BETWEEN date('{{ schedule.last_week_start }}', '-7 days') AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}' GROUP BY 渠道, 周 ORDER BY 渠道, 周

expectations.label: 上周退款率的上升来自结构变化还是各渠道自身

cases.question: 上周订单数下降算不算异常？

gold.sql: SELECT date(order_date, 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS 周, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND order_date BETWEEN date('{{ schedule.this_week_start }}', '-175 days') AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}' GROUP BY 周 ORDER BY 周

expectations.label: 上周订单数的变化在不在常规波动范围内

cases.question: 上周取消的订单是不是突然变多了？

gold.sql: SELECT date(order_date, 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS 周, COUNT(*) AS 取消单数 FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date BETWEEN date('{{ schedule.this_week_start }}', '-175 days') AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}' GROUP BY 周 ORDER BY 周

expectations.label: 上周取消单数是不是明显超出常规波动

cases.question: 线上销售额最近是什么走势？

gold.sql: SELECT date(order_date, 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS 周, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS 线上销售额 FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND channel = '线上' AND order_date BETWEEN date('{{ schedule.this_week_start }}', '-84 days') AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}' GROUP BY 周 ORDER BY 周

expectations.label: 最近 12 周线上销售额的走势

cases.question: 上周线上销售额涨了，是订单多了还是客单价高了？

gold.sql: SELECT date(order_date, 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS 周, SUM(amount) AS 线上销售额, COUNT(*) AS 订单数, SUM(amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS 客单价 FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND channel = '线上' AND order_date BETWEEN date('{{ schedule.last_week_start }}', '-7 days') AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}' GROUP BY 周 ORDER BY 周

expectations.label: 上周线上销售额的变化主要来自订单数还是客单价

cases.question: 最近四周，西南店的退款率是不是比华东高？

gold.sql: SELECT s.region AS 地区, SUM(o.status = 'refunded') AS 退款单数, COUNT(*) AS 订单数 FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON s.id = o.store_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND s.region IN ('西南', '华东') AND o.order_date BETWEEN date('{{ schedule.last_week_start }}', '-21 days') AND '{{ schedule.last_week_end }}' GROUP BY 地区 ORDER BY 地区

expectations.label: 西南和华东退款率的差异站不站得住

cases.question: 这周和上周比卖得怎么样？

gold.sql: SELECT date(order_date, 'weekday 0', '-6 days') AS 周, COUNT(*) AS 订单数, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 销售额 FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled' AND order_date >= '{{ schedule.last_week_start }}' GROUP BY 周 ORDER BY 周

expectations.label: 本周和上周能不能直接比
